versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Moths make free spell cards (Phials) that all cast one shared Recipe, and each apprentice played adds a line to it.
Pour Phials on one big unit and its Drawn neighbours, spread keywords wide, or buff another tribe's carry.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Wording pass: the Herald, Pavonia, the Alchymist, Carbonaria and Drawn now say how they count and how long gains last; fight casts aren't spells you cast.
Psyche and the Honeysuckle Nurse now work on the units next to their target, so they join the lamp-and-neighbours play.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Fixes: a unit's Phials now scale with its size only once a turn, ending the runaway lamp; Phials aren't items, so the Treacle Painter can't loop.
Rules for repeated and numbered keywords; the Grinder feeds the lamp, Shipton strips a keyword, and The Uncertain needs two held Phials.
